description: Prints a factorial table, then starts a '/* TODO' comment in main that is never closed and swallows the rest of the file.
injected_faults: line 15: block comment opened with '/*' is never closed with '*/'
notes: The file ends inside the comment (line 22); the lexical error is at the '/*' on line 15. Cascade: the code of main after the comment is lost, so the closing '}' of main is missing and a syntax error at EOF can follow. gcc: unterminated comment.
